verdict.thesis_summary: Near-term liquidity through the first amortisation (Oct 2027) is materially de-risked by the impending closing of the $95M ADB concessional facility (6y maturity, 2y grace period, pari passu, no guarantors) and ~$29M escrow cash release. However, capital structure remains inverted: quarterly interest (~$64M) exceeds quarterly cash EBITDA (~$56M in 2Q26), and distribution EBITDA is penalized by ~$20M/yr capex underinvestment clawbacks through 2030. Deleveraging beyond 2027 hinges on 375MW wind/storage portfolio monetisation, Pakistan disposal, and related-party loan recovery from Zorlu Holding.

positives: Impending $95M ADB Facility Closing: Concessional multilateral financing for OEDAŞ distribution capex (6-year tenor, 2-year grace period, ranking pari passu with Eurobonds with no guarantors) provides decisive runway through Oct 2027.
Escrow Release Liquidity Injection: ~$29M released into unrestricted cash in 2Q26, cushioning liquidity during seasonal working capital troughs.

Strong FiT Insulation Against Merchant Spot Volatility: While spot power prices collapsed to $20/MWh in 2Q26 (vs $61/MWh in 2Q25), ZOREN's high proportion of statutory YEKDEM geothermal and hydro generation cushioned EBITDA ($24M generation cash EBITDA maintained in 1Q26 and 2Q26).
Aggressive Domestic TRY Bank Deleveraging: Local TRY debt reduced from $83M in 1Q26 to $70M in 2Q26 and ~$55M currently, with target to extinguish most domestic bank debt by YE27.

Pipeline of Monetisable Strategic Assets: Non-dilutive liquidity catalysts include 375MW wind/storage pipeline (monetisable mid-2027 post-licence conversion), Pakistan generation assets, and Electrip JV exit.
negatives: Interest Coverage Inversion: Quarterly interest expense (~$64M) exceeds quarterly cash EBITDA ($56M in 2Q26; 1H26 cash EBITDA reached only $102M vs $270M management full-year guidance).
Regulatory Capex Clawback Drag: Distribution EBITDA suffers from regulatory clawbacks due to 2021-25 capex underinvestment (~$10M in 1H26, ~$10M in 2H26, and ~$20M annually through 2030).
Dorad Energy Proceeds Leakage: Only 21-40% of the ~$210M Dorad gross proceeds went toward debt reduction (down from 60% initially guided), diluting deleveraging velocity.

Elevated Refinancing Cliff Post-2027: While ADB loan covers the October 2027 amortisation, April 2028 amortisation and 2030 maturity remain vulnerable without major asset sales or parent equity support.
Related-Party Exposure: Substantial upstream loans to Zorlu Holding remain uncollateralized, creating parent contagion risk and capital trap.

background.business_overview: Zorlu Enerji Elektrik Üretim A.Ş. is Turkey's premier renewable IPP and regulated utility, operating 991 MW of installed capacity (305 MW geothermal, 344 MW wind, 119 MW hydro, 116 MW solar) alongside the OEDAŞ distribution grid serving 3M+ population in Central Anatolia.
background.asset_perimeter: Aegean geothermal core (Kızıldere I, II, III and Alaşehir), OEDAŞ electricity distribution grid across 5 Anatolian provinces, international wind in Pakistan (56.4 MW), and nationwide ZES fast-charging network.
background.ownership_governance: Controlled by Korteks Mensucat / Zorlu Holding. Financial advisors retained for capital structure and debt advisory.

recent_drivers: JPMorgan Rating Upgrade to Overweight (Aug 2026): JPM upgraded ZOREN 30s to OW (73.25 px / 23.3% YTW), citing high confidence that the $95M ADB loan secures cash flow through Oct 2027.
2Q26 Results Performance: Cash EBITDA of $56M ($24M generation, $32M distribution), FCF burn of ~$15M, and cash balance of ~$51M (supported by $29M escrow release).
Tariff Support vs Capex Drag: Distribution EBITDA benefited from April 2026 tariff adjustments, offset by $10M 1H26 underinvestment regulatory penalties.
Spot Power Price Compression: Average Turkish spot prices dropped to $20/MWh in 2Q26 (vs $61/MWh in 2Q25), demonstrating importance of FiT insulation.

historical_notes.title: Desk Synthesis: Core Credit Evolution (2024–2026) & Capital Structure Refinancing
historical_notes.source: Research Desk Synthesis / Notion Inbox Processing
historical_notes.summary: Multi-year credit thesis evolution: 2024 new bond issuance consolidated debt at HoldCo ($800M at 11%); 2025 Dorad Energy sale ($210M) improved cash but disappointed with only 21-40% allocated to debt paydown; 2026 hinges on closing the $95M ADB concessional loan which secures liquidity through Oct 2027 amortisation. Beyond 2027, asset sales (375MW portfolio, Pakistan), parent support, and debt extension determine recovery value.

historical_notes.title: Jefferies: 2Q26 Financial Results Review & Liquidity Analysis
historical_notes.summary: 2Q26 results broadly neutral. Cash EBITDA reached $56M ($24M generation, $32M distribution), cash balance at ~$51M with FCF burn of ~$15M. Escrow release of ~$29M supported liquidity. Distribution EBITDA benefited from April tariff hike but suffered from capex penalties. Local TRY debt reduced from $83M (1Q26) to $70M (2Q26) and $55M currently. Near-term liquidity manageable through 1st amortisation under ADB loan, but refi risk elevated post-2027.

historical_notes.title: JPMorgan: 2Q26 Pre-Call Results Review — Interest Coverage Inversion
historical_notes.summary: Neutral rating maintained. Cash declined to ~$51M as quarterly interest expense (~$64M) exceeded cash EBITDA ($56M). 1H26 cash EBITDA totaled $102M vs full-year guidance of $270M (downside acknowledged to $260-265M). Electricity spot prices recovered from 2Q26 lows ($20/MWh) but lagged 2025. Fundamental issue remains capital structure and high interest burden; preferred solution is asset sales or equity injection.

historical_notes.title: JPMorgan: Upgrade ZOREN 30s to Overweight on $95M ADB Concessional Facility Visibility
historical_notes.summary: Upgraded ZOREN 30s to Overweight at 73.25 price (23.3% YTW). ADB $95M Distribution loan at final approval for September 2026 disbursement with 6-year maturity, 2-year grace period, ranking pari passu with no guarantors. Distribution EBITDA impacted by regulatory underinvestment penalties (~$10M in 1H26, $10M in 2H26, $20M/yr to 2030). High confidence ADB loan covers Oct 2027 amortisation, though April 2028 requires asset sales or equity support.

historical_notes.title: JPMorgan: Turkish Power Sector Update — FiT Insulation vs Spot Power Volatility
historical_notes.summary: YTD Jan-May 2026 generation reached 731 GWh (-4% YoY; Geothermal 614 GWh, Hydro 117 GWh). Average spot power prices collapsed to $20/MWh in 2Q26 (vs $61/MWh in 2Q25 and $64/MWh in 1H25). ZOREN remains far less exposed to spot market volatility than peers (e.g. Aydem) due to statutory high-tariff YEKDEM feed-in contract coverage.

historical_notes.title: Jefferies: 2Q25 Review — Dorad Energy Monetisation Proceeds Allocation Concerns
historical_notes.summary: Distribution EBITDA benefited from a 35% tariff increase. Dorad transaction closed with ~$210M gross proceeds, but management allocated only 21-40% toward debt reduction (below initial 60% guidance). EBITDA guided broadly stable in 2026 with leverage falling gradually. Pakistan asset sale postponed.

historical_notes.title: JPMorgan Fireside Chat: Management Ring-Fencing & Vestel Contagion Insulation
historical_notes.summary: Management confirmed Zorlu Enerji is not expected to support Vestel; no material dividends or loans upstreamed to holding company. Dorad proceeds ring-fenced within energy perimeter for debt paydown and network capex. Overweight maintained on limited contagion risk.

historical_notes.title: Jefferies: New Bond Issue Analysis — $800M 11.00% Senior Notes Launch
historical_notes.summary: New $800M 5.5-year bond issued at IPT 11-11.25% (Jefferies fair value ~10%). Bond refinanced project-level bank debt and consolidated capital structure at HoldCo. International assets earmarked for disposal to deleverage below $1B net debt. Identified risks: high interest burden, FiT expiry post-2027, and related-party loans to Zorlu Holding.
